page_title: LOR 4-0 REN | Lorient v Rennes 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) plays a through ball but overhits it.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' The referee is firm and issues Laurent Abergel (Lorient) a deserved yellow card.
84' Panos Katseris (Lorient) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
84' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
83' The shots on goal statistics – 7:1.
80' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
79' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays a through ball but overhits it.
76' Panos Katseris (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
73' The game has come to an end for Arsene Kouassi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
73' Here is a change. Mahamadou Nagida is going off and Habib Beye gives the last tactical orders to Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
71' This is a yellow card! Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

71' That didn't go as planned. Pablo Pagis (Lorient) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Brice Samba, who easily kept it out.
69' 4 - 0 Theo Le Bris (Lorient) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 4:0.
68' It looks like Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
66' A substitution has been made. Aiyegun Tosin goes off and Theo Le Bris (Lorient) comes on.
65' 3 - 0 Pablo Pagis (Lorient) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
63' Fabian Rieder comes off the pitch to be replaced by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes).
63' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
62' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays a through ball but overhits it.

61' Laurent Abergel (Lorient)'s poor effort is easily saved by Brice Samba. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
60' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Bingourou Kamara comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' Arthur Avom (Lorient) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
56' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Dermane Karim is replaced by Pablo Pagis (Lorient).
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sambou Soumano as he is replaced by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
55' Panos Katseris (Lorient) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
55' Panos Katseris (Lorient) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

54' Panos Katseris (Lorient) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Brice Samba!
53' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
53' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

50' Rennes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' 2 - 0 Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) meets the well-taken corner kick and fires the ball in the left side of the net. What a goal!
47' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) will deliver the corner kick.
46' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) comes on the pitch for Formose Mendy.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' A precise low pass is received by Arthur Avom (Lorient), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal! Arthur Avom plays a pass to the feet of Sambou Soumano (Lorient) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.
45+2' Igor Silva (Lorient) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45+2' Seko Fofana (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
44' Fabian Rieder (Rennes) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
42' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' The game is interrupted. Formose Mendy (Lorient) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
40' Formose Mendy (Lorient) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Panos Katseris (Lorient) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Brice Samba comes off his line to intercept.
38' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is flagged for offside.
35' Dermane Karim (Lorient) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
34' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) swings in a cross from a free kick, but Brice Samba collects calmly.
34' Dangerous play by Fabian Rieder (Rennes). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.

33' What a poor attempt! Seko Fofana (Rennes) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
32' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Laurent Abergel (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
31' The linesman signals that Quentin Merlin (Rennes) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
30' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
27' A player from Lorient commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
24' Dermane Karim (Lorient) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
23' Panos Katseris (Lorient) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates.
23' Arthur Avom (Lorient) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
21' Seko Fofana (Rennes) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
21' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) delivers a long cross in an attempt to surprise the opponent's sleepy defence.

20' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Bingourou Kamara pulls off an easy save.
18' Panos Katseris (Lorient) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
16' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) replaces Mohamed Meite.
15' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
14' Lorient seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
11' The game is interrupted as Christopher Wooh (Rennes) is sent off by the referee.
9' Igor Silva (Lorient) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
6' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
6' A clumsy foul by Arthur Avom (Lorient) and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle.
5' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Seko Fofana (Rennes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' Panos Katseris (Lorient) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lorient are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jerome Brisard.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
